As of March 31, 2026, the number of venues was 1,318 locations and the number of members was 66,971.
entries.7f9a2e6e4a10314b: The company recognizes that, for its main customers, kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers, the market size measured against the child population is trending downward due to the declining birthrate, while expectations for the quality of education for each child are rising. Against this backdrop, given its implementation scale of 1,296 regular-curriculum physical education facilities, and 1,318 extracurricular locations with 66,971 members, the company positions the pursuit of high added value, high grade and high quality as the key to sustainable growth.

entries.c0c23f454c34dc73: The business provides management guidance and operational guidance to kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers. It offers management consulting, education consulting, operational guidance, training for facility staff, and planning of all communication activities related to early childhood education, as well as planning and production of printed materials. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥285 million, and the number of contracts was 233.

entries.c0d336938c4fc0c3: As of March 31, 2026, the number of facilities for regular-curriculum physical education instruction was 1,296, the number of locations for extracurricular physical education instruction was 1,318, and the membership was 66,971.
entries.cc098f2969b44f06: The company continues to support children’s growth through early childhood physical education and early childhood education, and states that it aims to become Japan’s leading comprehensive early childhood education, instruction and education company in early childhood physical education and early childhood education. In the Early Childhood Physical Education Instruction-Related Business, it aims to differentiate itself from other companies by raising the added value of existing services and to double the number of contracted facilities, and in the Extracurricular Physical Education Instruction business, it aims to double the number of club members through the evolution and development of its original curriculum. In the Consulting-Related Business, drawing on the experience of instruction at about 5,000 facilities nationwide, it aims to focus on the special individual training consulting business under its information-provision membership system and to double the number of members.
entries.cfce2cab4186f2ca: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales were ¥7,480 million, up 5.7% year on year.
entries.d29d8e7eeae3b6ba: Under contracts, the company's employees visit each kindergarten, nursery school and kodomo-en center to provide direct guidance for physical education classes held during childcare hours (in-class). The company also provides advice on the composition of events such as athletic meets and on the formulation of a one-year curriculum. As of March 31, 2026, the number of venues where the service was provided was 1,296 facilities.
entries.dfddc77662852395: As of March 31, 2026, the number of facilities for regular-curriculum physical education instruction was 1,296, the number of locations for extracurricular physical education instruction was 1,318, and the membership was 66,971. The number of consulting contracts was 233.
entries.e39774e19062fc71: Since its founding in 1972, the company has provided early childhood physical education instruction, building a system in which its own instructors visit kindergartens, nursery schools and kodomo-en centers nationwide to provide instruction. The standardization of instruction techniques through its original training programs and instructor grading system, together with the trust built over many years under the “Cosmo” brand, are positioned as the basis for its differentiation from other companies. Another feature is that the company can support the management and operation of facilities in addition to physical education instruction.
entries.e59a29b00657ac08: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net income was ¥1,143 million, up 31.1% year on year.
